description: Reviewed nominations for 2016-2025 index labels (#34), same rules as the 2010-2015 ledger: a nomination only selects which CIK to test. historical_identity_audit accepts it only when original SEC XBRL covers of that CIK report one of `sec_tickers` on at least two dates inside the evidence window (or the corroborated tier's conditions hold) and no other CIK reports the label there; historical_price_audit separately requires SEC listing-life and price-level checks. Found by comparing each fja05680 label with the lawcal candidate CIK and that CIK's first SEC periodic report (successor_cik_leak), or by labels without a lawcal candidate on the date (retrospective_label, missing_candidate).
